name: browser.scrape_markdown
description: Scrape a public HTTP/HTTPS page, optionally extract targeted article candidates, convert to clean Markdown, return it, and save it under the local scrapefiles folder.

args_schema.url: HTTP or HTTPS URL/domain to scrape
args_schema.instructions: optional user instructions describing what information to extract or emphasize
args_schema.mode: optional scrape mode: raw_page or targeted
args_schema.content_type: optional targeted content type, currently articles
args_schema.limit: optional maximum number of targeted items to extract
args_schema.format: optional output format: markdown or clean_markdown
args_schema.filename: optional Markdown filename; path traversal is ignored
args_schema.max_chars: optional maximum Markdown characters to return and save
